From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Baseline per-1M token rates, IO split & supported engines

Hi Melissa — thanks for the context and the pilot numbers. Quick answers below and I attached a short ratecard + sample SOW for procurement.

High-level billing model
- Redwood bills input and output tokens separately (per 1M tokens). This keeps upstream parsing/embedding costs and generation costs transparent.

Baseline hosted API (per 1M tokens) — standard, no committed discount:
- Small tier (recommended for prototypes / low-latency 7B-style models): input $0.18 / output $0.40 per 1M tokens
- Mid tier (13B-ish models): input $0.36 / output $0.85 per 1M tokens
- Large tier (70B+ high-quality models): input $0.95 / output $2.15 per 1M tokens
- Embeddings (per 1M input tokens processed for embedding requests): $0.50 per 1M tokens (embeddings are charged on the request side)

Example IO split (how you might model costs)
- If a chat request sends 500 input tokens and generates 1,500 output tokens, you'll be billed for 500 input + 1,500 output at the applicable tier rates.
- For your pilot (est. 500k tokens/day, ~70% generation), a rough daily cost estimate on the mid tier:
  - Input: 150k input tokens/day => 0.15 * $0.36 = $0.054 per day (per-1M basis scaled) — (we'll provide full calc in spreadsheet)
  - Output: 350k output tokens/day => 0.35 * $0.85 = $0.297 per day
(These quick numbers are meant to give direction — we usually build a small token-modeling sheet to capture real prompt sizes + generation lengths.)

Supported / recommended hosted engines
- Production: "Sentinel-L" (70B balance of quality/latency), "Helio-M" (13B, lower cost), "Cinder-7" (7B, fastest) — these are Redwood-verified entries in our catalog. Full catalog link below.
- We recommend starting pilot on a mid-tier (Helio-M) to validate prompts, then run a small A/B with Sentinel-L on heavier queries.

Discounts & committed paths
- Pilot (no commit): standard rates above + free onboarding credits (we can offer up to $25k credits on mutual NDA + quick POC).
- Committed monthly volume discounts (hosted): 8% at $25k/mo commit, 15% at $75k/mo, 25% at $250k/mo (these are examples — final pricing is in the quote).
- Dedicated pools: for strict performance/latency SLAs, we offer Dedicated capacity with a fixed monthly fee (ask us if you need predictable p95s).

Attachments included:
- Redwood_Baseline_Ratecard_v2.pdf (rate sheet, tier examples)
- Redwood_Sample_SOW.docx (procurement-ready SOW template)

Helpful links: https://redwood.ai/models/catalog (model families & perf guidelines)

If you can send an estimated monthly token curve (pilot -> 3 months -> steady state) and any compliance must-haves (SOC2, regional residency), I can turn this into a one-page formal quote. Marissa (cc'd) will support on contracts and discounts.

Available to hop on a 30-min call tomorrow if that helps.

— Jonas

Procurement asks:

Lastly — are there per-request minimums or throttling concerns for spikes? We often have bursty loads from nightly ingest jobs.

If you can send the table and spreadsheet, procurement will draft a PO/quote request. Happy to do a sync with Marissa later this week.

— Melissa
